# Which environment a task runs in

When a task is ready, choose the environment it runs in. If I have chosen
who takes the task myself, leave the task alone.

If the task has already been tried, leave its environment as it is: a retry
or a continuation keeps the environment of the attempt it continues.

Otherwise, use the project's default environment if it provides everything
the task needs. If it does not, use the environment the project allows that
provides everything the task needs and has the fewest extra capabilities.
If no environment the project allows provides everything the task needs,
leave the task for me, and say why on the task.

Every task is Standard, high effort, and any agent may take it.
